roadmap.title: Financial Data Architecture, Bank Statement Models & Transaction Schemas
roadmap.description: Core financial entities (Transaction, Account, Statement, Category), schema validation, and ISO currency/date normalization.

roadmap.title: Bank Statement Parser & Multi-Format Ingestion Engine
roadmap.description: Ingest CSV, OFX, and statement texts, column auto-detection, debit/credit polarity mapping, and duplicate transaction deduplication.

roadmap.title: AI Spending Analysis & Merchant Categorization Engine
roadmap.description: Merchant name normalization, automatic categorization (groceries, utilities, dining, subscription), recurring charge detector, and spending anomaly alerts.

roadmap.title: Intelligent Budgeting System & 50/30/20 Rule Allocator
roadmap.description: Dynamic budget envelope manager, 50/30/20 needs-wants-savings calculator, velocity & burn-rate tracker, and overspending warning alerts.

roadmap.title: Financial Cash Flow Forecaster & Runway Predictor
roadmap.description: Monte Carlo and moving-average balance projections, recurring bill runway estimation, upcoming deficit alerts, and end-of-month cash surplus forecasts.

roadmap.title: Smart Investment Suggestions & Savings Rate Optimizer
roadmap.description: Savings rate optimization algorithm, emergency fund requirement calculator, risk tolerance profiling, and diversified asset allocation recommendations.

roadmap.title: Automated Monthly Financial Reports Generator
roadmap.description: Executive financial summary builder, net cash flow calculation, savings rate benchmark, month-over-month category delta analysis, and exportable report markdown/JSON.

roadmap.title: "Chat with Your Expenses" Natural Language Query Agent
roadmap.description: Semantic search engine over transactions, conversational query processor (spending Q&A, historical comparisons), and expense insights generator.

roadmap.title: Interactive Personal Finance Web Dashboard & Analytics UI
roadmap.description: Responsive web interface, statement drag-and-drop upload zone, interactive spending charts, budget progress gauges, and real-time chat interface.

roadmap.title: End-to-End System Integration, Security Audit & v1.0.0 Release Packaging
roadmap.description: Comprehensive end-to-end integration test suite, REST API endpoints, transaction export/import (CSV/JSON), and production v1.0.0 release packaging.

history.milestone: Financial Data Architecture, Bank Statement Models & Transaction Schemas
